crossRefs.note: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of Yahweh our God.
Yahweh confused Sisera, all his chariots, and all his army, with the edge of the sword before Barak. Sisera abandoned…
For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots, and the sound of horses, even the noise of…
Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp…
The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with Yahweh.
I returned and saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to…
but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses;” therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift;” therefore…
Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for…
He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
“Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

translations.web: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.
translations.bsb: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.
translations.kjv: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
translations.asv: A horse is a vain thing for safety; Neither doth he deliver any by his great power.
